faqs.a: Yes: overall score, subscores, 2 strengths and 2 explained issues. The detailed diagnosis, priorities and PDF are in the one-time paid report.
We highlight traits that generally help or hurt ATS parsing. We do not reproduce a specific employer’s ATS score.
Files are stored privately, with no public URL, and can be deleted. Default retention is 30 days with automatic purge. See the Privacy page (Law 09-08 / CNDP).
